claims.text: The resort opened in December 2003.
The resort has 156 rooms in total.

findings.quote: Four Seasons Resort Jackson Hole sits at the base of the Teton Mountains in Teton Village and offers 156 luxury accommodations
findings.note: 156 total (d1 also lists Total Number of Rooms 156)

claims.text: The resort has 106 guest rooms.

findings.quote: including 106 guest rooms, 18 suites and 32 residences

claims.text: The resort has 18 suites.

findings.quote: including 106 guest rooms, 18 suites and 32 residences

claims.text: The resort is ski-in, ski-out, in a slope-side position at the base of Jackson Hole Mountain Resort.

findings.quote: Ski-in, ski-out, with a prime slope-side position at the base of Jackson Hole Mountain Resort

claims.text: The resort is on the doorstep of both Grand Teton National Park and Yellowstone National Park.

findings.quote: On the doorstep of both Grand Teton National Park and Yellowstone National Park

claims.text: The address is 7680 Granite Loop Road, Teton Village, Wyoming.

findings.quote: 7680 Granite Loop Road, P.O. Box 544, Teton Village, Wyoming, 83025, USA

claims.text: Jackson Hole Airport is 35 minutes by car from the resort.

findings.quote: Travel Time35 minutes by carDistance32 kilometres/20 miles
findings.note: under Jackson Hole Airport (JAC) transport hub

claims.text: Steadfire Chophouse is a modern chophouse serving from breakfast to dinner.

findings.quote: From breakfast to dinner, Steadfire is refreshingly modern while anchored in the heart of the American frontier.

claims.text: The Handle Bar is an American pub and beer hall in Teton Village.

findings.quote: Grab a seat at The Handle Bar, our American pub and beer hall in Teton Village

claims.text: Ascent Lounge is a slope-side bar serving Pan-Asian inspired plates.

findings.quote: See what our creative bartenders have in store this season at our popular slope-side bar in Jackson Hole, where Pan-Asian inspired plates are best shared either by the wood-burning fireplace or outside on the heated patio.

claims.text: The spa has 16 treatment rooms.
Mountain-Side Rooms each have a private balcony with views of sunsets over Rendezvous Mountain.

findings.quote: Each of these rooms features a private balcony, where the views of colourful sunsets over Rendezvous Mountain and the star-filled night skies are guaranteed to leave an impression.

claims.text: Valley-Side Rooms feature a gas fireplace and balcony.

findings.quote: Settle into your cosy room that features a gas fireplace and balcony, as you reflect on your day’s adventure and those to come.

claims.text: 80 Proof is a speakeasy-style private bar reminiscent of the prohibition era.

findings.quote: Step into this hidden private bar reminiscent of the prohibition era

claims.text: The Two-Bedroom Resort Residence has a fully equipped kitchen and laundry room.

findings.quote: Enjoy the comforts of home with a fully equipped kitchen and laundry room, coupled with luxuries such as a steam shower and deep-soaking tub.

claims.text: Complimentary s'mores and hot chocolate are served poolside during winter months.

findings.quote: Complimentary s'mores and hot chocolate served poolside during winter months

claims.text: Valet parking is available at the resort, and there is no parking at the resort for RVs.

findings.quote: Valet parking is available, with unlimited in-and-out privileges. Ask our Concierge for more details. There is no parking at the Resort for RVs.

claims.text: Overnight RV parking is at Ranch Lot in Teton Village, a 10-minute walk from the resort.

findings.quote: Ranch Lot in Teton Village – a 10-minute walk from the Resort – offers overnight RV parking

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the exclusive mountain resort experience.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
